content.short: Peer-to-peer USDC and fiat swaps fast enough to pay at any local QR code.
content.description: P2P.me matches users with more than 1,000 verified liquidity partners who swap USDC for local currency through their own bank accounts, with orders settled on-chain. It started in India, where bank freezes after crypto transfers are a common fear, and it is designed so users can buy, sell or pay at a store QR without that risk. Liquidity partners earn up to 2% per swap, and the project is backed by Coinbase Ventures and Multicoin.
content.meta: Swap USDC and local fiat peer to peer with verified partners on P2P.me, fast enough to pay at any store QR.
